stemMd: A data set has mean 12. Every observation is increased by 5. What is the new mean?

options.label: D
options.textMd: It depends on the number of observations

explanationMd: If there are n observations, their total increases by 5n. Dividing the new total by n increases the mean by five. The new mean is therefore seventeen.

distractorRationale.a: Adding the same constant to every value shifts the mean.
distractorRationale.d: The mean shifts by the same constant regardless of sample size.
